note: The dataflow of one decoder layer at decode, as nodes and the values each reads. A weight node is named by its tensor's fine role (boltbeam/vocab.py RoleClass) and reads one value through its matrix; every other node is named by what it computes. A value is named by the node that produces it, or is the layer's input stream (residual). The fusion search (search/fusion_space.py) reads this table to say which nodes are adjacent, which values a set of nodes reads from outside, and how BoltBeam computes their output itself (the op column). A node whose op BoltBeam has no reference for (rms_norm, attention) cannot be inside a fusion BoltBeam checks.

inputs.residual: the residual stream entering the layer
